title: Ladies and gentlemen - Opus 5.5 👏
author: MartinTale
selftext:
I made a BLAST - multiplayer blow-'em-up game inspired by Bomberman 💣💥

This literally took just few hours with Opus 5.5 🤯

[https://blast.martintale.com/](https://blast.martintale.com/)

replies.author: MartinTale
replies.body: I mean, it's not a single prompt - took few sessions over 4 or so hours to build but still impressive imo 😊

replies.author: yaxir
replies.body:
oh i fully acknowledge that. would you be ok to guide me if i dm'ed you?

i will appreciate some advice on prompting!!

replies.author: MartinTale
replies.body:
it's genuinely just start with "make a multiplayer bombarmen game" and then just "change this ...", "change that ...", there's no magic - just takes a bit of time to explain what you want 😊  
Have you made games before?

replies.author: yaxir
replies.body: yes, in Unity, i programmed in C#

replies.author: MartinTale
replies.body: I think unity even has ai tools now and a lot of people have recommended me to try using it as it’s so powerful and cross platform

replies.author: yaxir
replies.body: hmm.. so a combo of AI (Opus 5.5 or Astra) plus Unity and utilize my C# experience where neccessary?

replies.author: MartinTale
replies.body: exactly 😉

replies.author: pickleunicorn
replies.body: We're not anymore at a stage where we really need to prompt engineer things ahah

replies.author: yaxir
replies.body: It's not really about prompt engineering. It's more about efficiently using the limited usage. Both Astra and Opus 5.5, I believe, have very, very low usage limits even on the $100 plans. That's why I was looking for some advice on resourceful prompting

replies.author: pickleunicorn
replies.body: Ah ok, I understand better :D Well, I tested Astra with 23$ subscription. It's good at doing some 3D stuff, and also it understands you well. But Claude is way better at coding. I didn't try Opus 5.5, but I'm currently using Fable 5.1 on a 100$ sub and it works like charm. Really a game changer (even if limited in usage). I don't really like Opus 4.8. I'm using it everyday at work and it's so dumb from time to time to understand things, and it's subject to shift from its initial goal when context gets big...

replies.author: yaxir
replies.body:
my main qualm is that i wont have time to do all the stuff (Art, animation, GFX design, VFX design) as i will be making a game but also busy with my studies (im also a student)

i also use Chatgpt for help with my studies (just help with research work haha)

so i'm thinking if Codex usage will be enough when it uses tools like Blender or others when making game levels, character models, animations, vfx etc etc

how much does Fable use its usage % when you push it to make VFX and Graphical stuff through tools (Blender/Godot or whatever game design tool you use with AI)?

replies.author: pickleunicorn
replies.body: It's hard for me to compare because I don't have the same subscriptions. But to my experience Fable > Astra > Opus. And since Fable is only usage with a 100$ subscription, for half of the credit maximum, it's clearly good enough. I'm using it since yesterday, non stop, and the usage does not move that much because you don't output a lot of code really, and you don't really prompt that much either. It takes all its time in tests and thinking. If you want to make a game that will be simpler to handle, I really think Fable is the right answer. Do you have a bit of programming or code architecture knowledge ?

replies.author: yaxir
replies.body:
yes, i'm a computer engineer :)

i programmed games before with C# in Unity, but now i am quite busy in my studies, so the best i can do is mostly directing what to do in terms of gameplay mechanics and vfx/gfx, story writing, play testing the game and tweaks where necessary

i have never worked with graphic design/game artist stuff tho

in your opinion, Fable is a better workhorse than Opus (from what i gather from your experience, Fable does most of the things behind the scenes and only outputs something when necessary)

i am tempted to try $100 Claude sub now, but i will wait for your reply here first :)

replies.author: pickleunicorn
replies.body: I'm trying Opus 5.5 since yesterday, and it's clearly better than Opus 4.8, but Fable is still the best model IMO, even if Anthropic says the contrary. I think the good idea is to use Opus 5.5 by default, and then Fable on complicated things that Opus cannot handle.

replies.author: yaxir
replies.body: Thank you so much. I really really appreciate your feedback because I've been very anxious to spend more money on stuff. You might just have convinced me to try at least 1 month of Claude even though my previous experience was not that good. Then again I wasn't really using MCP or all that shit. Thank you so much. I have annoyed you so much already but one last question will be: do you think Opus drains the usage faster than Fable or are they nearly the same?

comments.author: yaxir
comments.body: and how much of your weekly and 5 hour usage was depleted?

replies.author: MartinTale
replies.body:
I hit 5h limit once and weekly limit was drained a bit 10-20%

https://preview.redd.it/os8as2nauarh1.png?width=450&format=png&auto=webp&s=328b9dbdd33e541bfb74d777ead864c0bfc7896e

replies.author: stream_of_thought1
replies.body: that is insane! I burn through my GPT subscription by just doing regular work stuff.

comments.author: Romellija
comments.body: This looks great. I oneshotted a much shittier version the other day just to mess around with it cos I loved playing Bomberman when I was younger. You should definitely expand this in my biased opinion

replies.author: MartinTale
replies.body: Definitely could do more with it - will see and thank you 🙏

comments.author: CycleMother2006
comments.body: Opus 5.5 really pulling out the guns with its animation quality.  Though I don't expect the boost there to last more than a week if their previous behaviours are any indication. I'm so sick of Anthropic rug pulling models with its aggressive quantization.

replies.author: MartinTale
replies.body: Yes, that's very true.. Enjoying it while it lasts tho 😊

replies.author: odragora
replies.body: Unfortunately it's the same with Codex now.

replies.author: CycleMother2006
replies.body: Yeah I've seen it as well. It's really gone downhill since the first week. Still does a good job if you push it to do gauntleted loops, but its individual intelligence and assertion has taken a  fairly steep nosedive. Its performance in the reviewer comparisons of Astra vs Opus 5.5 is fairly clear on this too, with Opus basically winning out on things that original Astra impressions would've blown out of the water.

replies.author: odragora
replies.body: And it seems like 6.0 is rebranded 5.6 Terra with some post-training, while 5.6 Sol is getting retired.

comments.author: asscrit
comments.body: i started in an area where i had to bomb myself. also where is the famous x killed y message?

replies.author: MartinTale
replies.body:
It’s there but I guess it’s way too small to see 😅

It should be visible in top left and in center if you lose 🫡

Cool, tried it out 😊

I’m using https://colyseus.io/ 😉

 I think it’s a quite a common expression in general 😊

replies.body: Thank you 😊

replies.author: MartinTale
replies.body: thank you 🙏

comments.author: bunguardian
comments.body: Cool game but it killed my mobile battery LOL. Went from 10 to 1% in a minute. Please optimize.

replies.author: MartinTale
replies.body: You're right 😬 I'll do that now 😉

replies.author: bunguardian
replies.body: Thanks!

replies.author: MartinTale
replies.body:
added some quick and easy optimizations but they should make the situation a lot better already.. 

any chance you can try it out (need to hard refresh/open in a new tab) 😇

replies.author: MartinTale
replies.body:
Oh I saw you 😅🥰

Thank you ☺️

comments.author: LearnToSketch
comments.body: Congratulations! Great game, however you built it! Made in hours showcased 5.5 but also your incredible understanding of game making!

replies.author: MartinTale
replies.body: Thank you 🙏

comments.body: Are you feeding it the art assets or is going and finding them itself?

replies.body: It’s all made in code 😊
